info.title: Freundebuch API
info.description:
A personal CRM for two: people, the conversations with them, and what to remember before the next one.

Every error is JSON, `{"error": "...", "code": "..."}`. Besides the responses listed per operation, an unknown path under /api/v1 answers 404 (`not_found`), a method an operation doesn't have answers 405 with `Allow`, and a failure on the server's side answers 500 (`internal`) without details.
